previous.title: Use familiar terms for your content and actions

statement.en: Choose or apply familiar terms for your content and actions in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではfamiliar terms for your content and actionsを採用する。

conditions: Choose intent and entity terminology that people are likely to recognize naturally.

current.title: Use recognizable Siri terminology

statement.en: Use familiar terms for content and actions exposed to Siri.
statement.ja: Siriに公開するコンテンツや操作には、利用者になじみのある用語を使う。

conditions: Choose recognizable terminology for app intents and entities.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph15: familiar words support natural interaction; remove broken bilingual templates.

previous.title: Offer relevant content

statement.en: Make relevant content available when applicable.
statement.ja: 必要な場合にrelevant contentを利用可能にする。

conditions: Prioritize content relevant to personal context, such as recent searches, favorites, bookmarks, or wishlists.
exceptions: A category such as email or messaging may have a reason to expose a broader catalog.

current.title: Expose personally relevant content

statement.en: Offer content relevant to the person when making app content available through Spotlight and Siri.
statement.ja: SpotlightやSiriにアプリのコンテンツを公開するときは、その人に関連するものを提供する。

conditions: Consider recently searched content, favorites, bookmarks, or wishlists as examples of personal relevance.
exceptions: Email, messaging, or another appropriate app category may treat its entire catalog as relevant and provide expanded access.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph17 retains relevance and the explicit broader-catalog exception.

previous.title: Never include advertising in Siri-delivered content

statement.en: Never include advertisements, marketing, or in-app purchase sales pitches in content Siri delivers.
statement.ja: Siriがdeliverするcontentにadvertisement、marketing、in-app purchase sales pitchを含めない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Exclude advertising from Siri content

statement.en: Never include advertisements, marketing, or in-app purchase sales pitches in content Siri delivers.
statement.ja: Siriが提供するコンテンツに、広告、マーケティング、アプリ内購入の売り込みを含めない。

conditions: Applies to content delivered by Siri, not all marketing outside that experience.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph19 explicitly prohibits advertising; preserve existing MUST_NOT and prioritize the requested experience.

previous.title: Write response dialogue that’s clear and descriptive

statement.en: Apply the documented Siri guidance to write response dialogue that’s clear and descriptive.
statement.ja: 「Siri」において「Write response dialogue that’s clear and descriptive」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Clearly describe what happens when Siri performs the action.
The mandatory follow-up-dialogue customization is recorded separately.

current.title: Write clear Siri response dialogue

statement.en: Write clear, descriptive Siri response dialogue that explains the result of an action.
statement.ja: 操作の結果が伝わる、明確で具体的なSiriの応答文を書く。

conditions: Applies when providing custom properties for schema responses; follow-up dialogue customization is separately required by0018.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph29 supports the general writing recommendation; the be-sure clause remains separate.

previous.title: Keep responses as succinct as possible

statement.en: Maintain responses as succinct as possible.
statement.ja: responses as succinct as possibleを維持する。

conditions: Use current-conversation context to remove details that people don't need to hear repeatedly.

current.title: Keep Siri responses concise

statement.en: Keep Siri responses as concise as possible.
statement.ja: Siriの応答は、可能な限り簡潔にする。

conditions: Use the current conversation context to remove repeated or unnecessary details.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph31 retains as-possible qualifier and repeated-conversation context.

previous.title: Ensure Siri responses work audibly and visually

statement.en: Ensure Siri can deliver each app-provided response both audibly and visually.
statement.ja: app提供の各Siri responseをaudibleとvisualの両方でdeliverできるようにする。

conditions: Let Siri choose the delivery method appropriate to the current device and context.

current.title: Support audible and visual Siri delivery

statement.en: Ensure Siri can deliver app-provided responses both audibly and visually.
statement.ja: アプリが提供する応答を、Siriが音声と画面の両方で伝えられるようにする。

conditions: Siri chooses the delivery method appropriate to the device and current situation; this does not require both methods to occur simultaneously.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph33: retain the existing accessibility/platform-delivery MUST classification; the lead says Provide, while0020 has explicit make-sure support.

previous.title: Design inclusive interactions

statement.en: Apply the documented Siri guidance to design inclusive interactions.
statement.ja: 「Siri」において「Design inclusive interactions」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Create welcoming responses for everyone and avoid unnecessary assumptions about identity.

current.title: Design inclusive Siri interactions

statement.en: Create welcoming Siri interactions without unnecessary assumptions about a person.
statement.ja: 相手について不要な決めつけをせず、誰もが使いやすいSiriのやり取りを設計する。

conditions: Avoid specific pronouns when they are unnecessary; do not infer the gender of a contact.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph35 gives pronoun examples within inclusive interaction design.

previous.title: Ask an open-ended question when the full list of options is too long

statement.en: Apply the documented Siri guidance to ask an open-ended question when the full list of options is too long.
statement.ja: 「Siri」において「Ask an open-ended question when the full list of options is too long」の指針を適用する。

conditions: The full option list would take too long for Siri to read.
Use the open-ended question to narrow scope or collect needed detail.

current.title: Narrow overly long spoken option lists

statement.en: When reading all options would take too long, ask an open-ended Siri question to narrow the choices.
statement.ja: 選択肢をすべて読み上げると長くなる場合は、Siriで自由に答えられる質問をして候補を絞る。

conditions: Use the question to narrow scope or obtain additional detail.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph37 preserves the long-list condition rather than requiring open-ended questions everywhere.

previous.title: Keep responses device-independent whenever possible

statement.en: Maintain responses device-independent whenever possible.
statement.ja: responses device-independent whenever possibleを維持する。

conditions: Account for a request starting on one device and taking effect on another.

current.title: Prefer device-independent responses

statement.en: Keep Siri responses device-independent whenever possible.
statement.ja: 可能な限り、特定の端末に依存しないSiriの応答にする。

conditions: A request can begin on one device and take effect on another.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph39 retains whenever-possible;0021 separately requires accurate device references when necessary.

previous.title: Ensure Siri responses respect parental controls

statement.en: Ensure app-provided Siri responses use appropriate language and respect parental controls.
statement.ja: app提供のSiri responseでappropriate languageを使いparental controlを尊重する。

conditions: Account for explicit-content restrictions and the possibility that nearby people can hear an audible response.

current.title: Respect language and parental restrictions

statement.en: Ensure app-provided Siri responses use appropriate language and respect parental controls.
statement.ja: アプリが提供するSiriの応答では、適切な言葉を使い、保護者による制限を尊重する。

conditions: Account for explicit-content and rating restrictions and for nearby people hearing an audible response.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph43 retains the existing user-control MUST classification; offensive dialogue is independently prohibited by0022.

previous.title: Help people understand errors and failures

statement.en: Apply the documented Siri guidance to help people understand errors and failures.
statement.ja: 「Siri」において「Help people understand errors and failures」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Enhance default error text with information specific to the current failure.

current.title: Explain Siri failures specifically

statement.en: Help people understand Siri errors with information specific to the current failure.
statement.ja: その状況に即した情報で、Siriのエラーや失敗の理由をわかりやすく伝える。

conditions: Enhance system default error descriptions when a more specific explanation is available.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph45 recommends a concrete failure explanation, not just a generic failure message.

previous.title: Be aware that the system reserves important actions and phrases for Siri

statement.en: Apply the documented Siri guidance to be aware that the system reserves important actions and phrases for Siri.
statement.ja: 「Siri」において「Be aware that the system reserves important actions and phrases for Siri」の指針を適用する。

conditions: The explicit impersonation, Apple-attribution, and reserved-phrase prohibitions are recorded separately.

current.title: Account for Siri-reserved actions

statement.en: Account for the actions and phrases reserved by the system for Siri.
statement.ja: システムがSiri専用としている操作やフレーズを考慮する。

conditions: The independent prohibitions on impersonation, false Apple attribution, and reserved phrases remain in0024–0026.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph50 separates awareness-level guidance from explicit prohibitions.

previous.title: Identify your app’s most popular actions, and when and where they occur

statement.en: Determine your app’s most popular actions, and when and where they occur explicitly.
statement.ja: your app’s most popular actions, and when and where they occurを明確に特定する。

conditions: Use action frequency and context to prioritize which intents, entities, and content to expose.

current.title: Prioritize common Siri actions

statement.en: Identify the app’s most popular actions and the contexts in which people use them.
statement.ja: アプリでよく使われる操作と、それが使われる状況を特定する。

conditions: Consider when, where, hands-free use, and the relevant device to prioritize app intents and entities.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph13 supports context-driven prioritization without requiring new analytics collection.

statement.en: Refer to siri by name.
statement.ja: Siri by nameという名称で参照する。

conditions: Use the word Siri directly; the separate pronoun rule records the discouraged wording.

statement.en: Refer to Siri using the name Siri.
statement.ja: Siriを指すときは、Siriという名前を使う。

conditions: The discouraged use of personal pronouns is separately recorded in0023.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph48 explicitly prefers the name; restore capitalization and natural Japanese.

previous.title: Ensure a custom response is used only when built-in responses are insufficient

statement.en: Ensure the app provides a custom Siri response only when built-in responses don't meet its needs.
statement.ja: built-in responseでappのneedsを満たせない場合だけcustom Siri responseを提供する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Use custom responses only when needed

statement.en: Provide a custom Siri response only when built-in responses do not meet the app’s needs.
statement.ja: 標準の応答でアプリの必要を満たせない場合に限り、Siriの応答を独自に定義する。

conditions: Assess built-in responses before providing a custom response.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph21 explicitly says Only; preserve the conditional MUST rather than requiring custom responses.

previous.title: Omit your app name from responses

statement.en: Omit the app name from Siri responses because the system already provides attribution.
statement.ja: systemがattributionを提供するためSiri responseからapp nameを省く。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Omit redundant app attribution

statement.en: Omit the app name from Siri responses because the system already attributes the response.
statement.ja: システムが応答元を示すため、Siriの応答文からアプリ名を省く。

conditions: The system provides verbal and visual app attribution.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph41 supports omission; does not remove system attribution.

previous.title: Ensure Siri features and content are exposed through App Intents

statement.en: Ensure the app exposes Siri-accessible features and content through the App Intents framework.
statement.ja: Siriから利用するapp featureとcontentをApp Intents frameworkで公開する。

conditions: Apply when the app is intended to work with Siri and Apple Intelligence.

current.title: Expose Siri functionality with App Intents

statement.en: Use the App Intents framework to make the app’s features and content available to Apple Intelligence for Siri.
statement.ja: Siriと連携するため、App Intentsフレームワークでアプリの機能とコンテンツをApple Intelligenceに公開する。

conditions: Applies when making the app work with Siri in the documented Apple Intelligence integration context; this is not a claim of feature availability on every listed device.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph4 says has to; preserve mandatory integration prerequisite without inferring SDK or device availability.

previous.title: Ensure follow-up dialogue is customized for clarity

statement.en: Ensure default Siri dialogue is customized for clarity when asking follow-up questions.
statement.ja: follow-up questionを尋ねる場合はdefault Siri dialogueをclarityのためにcustomizeする。

conditions: Apply when a custom response asks a follow-up question.

current.title: Customize follow-up dialogue for clarity

statement.en: When asking a Siri follow-up question, customize the default dialogue so the question is clear.
statement.ja: Siriで追加の質問をするときは、質問が明確になるよう標準の応答文を調整する。

conditions: Applies when custom schema responses ask a follow-up question.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph29 says be sure; preserve conditional MUST.

previous.title: Avoid including unnecessary words or attempts at humor

statement.en: Exclude including unnecessary words or attempts at humor from the applicable experience.
statement.ja: 該当する体験ではincluding unnecessary words or attempts at humorを避ける。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Avoid filler and repeated humor

statement.en: Avoid unnecessary words or attempts at humor in Siri responses.
statement.ja: Siriの応答に、不要な言葉や笑いを狙った表現を入れることを避ける。

conditions: People may hear the same response repeatedly during follow-up questions or errors.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph31 explicitly says Avoid; retain AVOID.

previous.title: Ensure every voice response stands on its own

statement.en: Ensure every Siri voice response stands on its own without relying on visual elements for essential information.
statement.ja: 各Siri voice responseをessential informationのためにvisual elementへ依存せず単独で理解できるようにする。

conditions: Essential information must remain available when the response is delivered without a visual interface.

current.title: Make voice responses self-contained

statement.en: Ensure Siri voice responses convey essential information without depending on visual elements.
statement.ja: Siriの音声応答だけで、画面の要素に頼らず必要な情報が伝わるようにする。

conditions: Applies when a response is delivered without a visual interface.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph33 explicitly says make sure; prioritize nonvisual access.

previous.title: Ensure every device reference is accurate in context

statement.en: When a Siri response must name a device, ensure the reference is accurate and makes sense in context.
statement.ja: Siri responseでdevice名が必要な場合はreferenceを正確かつcontextに適合させる。

conditions: Use a device-specific reference only when it is necessary.

current.title: Keep necessary device references accurate

statement.en: When a Siri response needs to name a device, ensure the reference is accurate and makes sense in context.
statement.ja: Siriの応答で端末を特定する必要がある場合は、その表現が正確で、状況に合っていることを確認する。

conditions: Device-specific wording is conditional, not required for every response.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph39 says if and make sure; preserve conditional MUST.

previous.title: Never include offensive language in app-provided Siri dialogue

statement.en: Never include offensive language in app-provided Siri dialogue.
statement.ja: app提供のSiri dialogueにoffensive languageを含めない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Exclude offensive Siri dialogue

statement.en: Never include offensive language in app-provided Siri dialogue.
statement.ja: アプリが提供するSiriの応答文に、不快感を与える攻撃的な言葉を含めない。

conditions: Applies to dialogue text the app supplies.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph43 explicitly says Don’t include; retain existing MUST_NOT protecting the interaction.

previous.title: Avoid referring to Siri with personal pronouns

statement.en: Avoid referring to Siri with personal pronouns such as she, him, or her.
statement.ja: Siriをshe、him、herなどのpersonal pronounで参照しない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Avoid pronouns for Siri

statement.en: Avoid referring to Siri with personal pronouns such as she, him, or her.
statement.ja: Siriを指すときは、she、him、herなどの人称代名詞を使うことを避ける。

conditions: Use the name Siri directly.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph48 and existing reviewed AVOID distinguish editorial wording from the Never/Only trademark restrictions.

previous.title: Never impersonate Siri or reproduce its functionality

statement.en: Never impersonate Siri or attempt to reproduce the functionality Siri provides.
statement.ja: SiriをimpersonateしたりSiriのfunctionalityを再現しようとしたりしない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Do not impersonate Siri

statement.en: Never impersonate Siri or attempt to reproduce the functionality Siri provides.
statement.ja: Siriになりすましたり、Siriが提供する機能を再現しようとしたりしない。

conditions: Applies to app-provided interactions and responses in the Siri integration context.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph50 explicitly says Never; retain platform-reserved behavior restriction without expanding beyond Siri integration.

previous.title: Never make an app response appear to come from Apple

statement.en: Never provide an app response that appears to come from Apple.
statement.ja: Appleから発信されたように見えるapp responseを提供しない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Do not imply responses come from Apple

statement.en: Never provide an app response that appears to come from Apple.
statement.ja: Appleが発信したように見えるアプリの応答を提供しない。

conditions: Applies to attribution of the app’s response.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph50 prohibits false Apple attribution; prioritize transparent user understanding.

previous.title: Never use Siri-reserved phrases in app responses

statement.en: Never use Siri-reserved phrases such as “Call 911” or “Hey Siri” in app responses.
statement.ja: app responseで「Call 911」や「Hey Siri」などSiri-reserved phraseを使わない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Do not use Siri-reserved phrases

statement.en: Never use Siri-reserved phrases such as “Call 911” or “Hey Siri” in app responses.
statement.ja: アプリの応答で、「Call 911」や「Hey Siri」などのSiri専用フレーズを使わない。

conditions: These are examples of reserved phrases, not an exhaustive list or localized emergency-service instructions.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph50 explicitly prohibits reserved phrases; scope is system-reserved Siri behavior, not independent emergency guidance.

previous.title: Ensure localization changes only “Hey” in “Hey Siri”

statement.en: In localized “Hey Siri,” ensure only the word “Hey” is translated.
statement.ja: localized「Hey Siri」では「Hey」だけをtranslateする。

conditions: Use the acceptable translation listed by Apple for the target locale.

current.title: Localize only Hey in Hey Siri

statement.en: When localizing “Hey Siri,” translate only “Hey” using Apple’s accepted wording for the locale.
statement.ja: 「Hey Siri」を現地語にする場合は、対象の言語・地域でAppleが認める表記を用い、「Hey」だけを翻訳する。

conditions: The source table provides accepted locale-specific forms; do not invent a translation or require a change where the accepted form stays “Hey Siri.”

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph52 and table54 state only-Hey; retain MUST with locale context.

previous.title: Never translate the Siri trademark

statement.en: Never translate the word Siri in a localized “Hey Siri” phrase.
statement.ja: localized「Hey Siri」phrase内のSiriをtranslateしない。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

current.title: Keep the Siri trademark untranslated

statement.en: Never translate the name Siri in a localized “Hey Siri” phrase.
statement.ja: 現地語の「Hey Siri」でも、Siriという名前は翻訳しない。

conditions: Siri remains an Apple trademark in the localized phrase.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph52 explicitly says never translated; preserve MUST_NOT and trademark/legal priority.
